notes: azcus.digikey.com: NOT a normal Digi-Key regional storefront. Digi-Key's regional stores are country domains (www.digikey.com, digikey.co.uk, .de, .be, .ca, ...); 'azcus' names no country and matches Azure's 'Central US' region code, so it is most likely an infrastructure/origin host (a deployment of the US site), not a test host like punchouttest.* - but no public page describes it (2 searches found nothing). Its prices match www.digikey.com where both were seen (e.g. NVBG020N120SC1, TLI4971A050). Recommendation: do not treat it as disallowed like punchouttest, but do not let it be the ONLY source for a catalogue price; cite www.digikey.com or a second distributor. 149 catalogue/research URLs already use this host.
